calibration.regional_method: P75/P90 of daily observed strong-label fractions on training days with >=5% support coverage. Demonstration heuristic; not operationally validated.
calibration.threshold_selection: Macro F1 is primary. Candidates within 0.005 absolute F1 of the best form the near-tie set; choose highest regional any-warning F1, then minimum rare-class F1, lower false-warning frequency, fewer missed strong days, macro F1. Report all class-specific and warning tradeoffs. Seasonal inputs are eligible only after the predeclared controlled experiment retains them.
calibration.regional_validation_status: Research prototype: regional skill is insufficient and labels are chlorophyll proxies. Independent verified HAB validation is required before operational warning delivery.

regional.methodology: Primary daily counts use horizon 1: one target day per origin. All-horizon counts are distinct forecast cases, not independent days. Actual regional strong fraction uses only observed proxy labels, qualified at >=5% marine support. Predicted fraction uses dense training-supported cells. P75/P90 thresholds are fixed from 2021-2023. Missing target observations are UNKNOWN. Unavailable-input high-risk days remain missed warnings, with abstention counts reported. Hindcast availability is assessed at origin, not using today's age; product delivery latency is unknown.

test_disclosure: 2025 was inspected in earlier work. It was excluded from this improvement development; the final frozen configuration is evaluated once. This is a previously inspected holdout, not an untouched test.
scoring_note: Pixel metrics use exactly the same valid corrected target labels for baseline and final, including low-input cases. Rolling horizons repeat dates at distinct origins. Regional metrics separately count coverage abstentions as misses on observed high-risk days. No parameters changed after the final freeze.
